replacements.Las tres palancas del test-time compute: The three levers of test-time compute
replacements.Más cómputo en tiempo de inferencia prod: More inference-time compute produces better answers on reasoning problems. Each lever has a different quality, cost and latency profile.
replacements.El modelo genera pasos intermedios que d: The model generates intermediate steps that decompose the problem before giving the final answer. Each step uses tokens in the context, but the answer benefits from having solved the subproblems explicitly.
replacements.Mejor en: razonamiento encadenado, matem: Best for: chained reasoning, mathematics, code with complex dependencies
replacements.Coste: proporcional al número de tokens: Cost: proportional to the number of tokens generated internally
replacements.En lugar de una sola respuesta, el model: Instead of a single answer, the model generates N independent answers and selects the best one. The principle is statistical: if each individual answer has probability p of being correct and the answers are sufficiently independent, N candidates increase the probability that at least one is correct.
replacements.Selección por mayoría o por modelo de pu: Selection by majority vote or scoring model
replacements.Mejor en: problemas donde la respuesta e: Best for: problems where the answer is verifiable (executable code, mathematics)
replacements.Coste: N × coste de una respuesta indivi: Cost: N × the cost of one individual answer
replacements.En lugar de una cadena lineal, el modelo: Instead of a linear chain, the model explores multiple reasoning branches in parallel, evaluates the progress of each branch and discards the less promising ones before continuing. The result is broader exploration of the solution space.
replacements.Mejor en: planificación compleja, optimi: Best for: complex planning, optimization, problems with a broad search space
replacements.Coste: órdenes de magnitud mayor que la: Cost: orders of magnitude higher than a linear chain — requires PRMs to be efficient
